title: Babel Federation Window
description: Universal Babel-Index rolling window record for cross-instance research pooling. Runtime-agnostic; NEOTH is the v0 reference runtime. Replaces neoth-babel-window.schema.json v0.1.0.

duration_seconds.description: Minimum 60 s to prevent re-identification via timing.

prediction_horizon_seconds.description: Look-ahead used when computing collapse labels. 900 = primary.

runtime.description: Runtime identifier. Recommended values: NEOTH, other registered runtime ids from metadata/registered-runtimes.yml.

runtime_class.description: Runtime class for cross-runtime stratification in pooled analysis.

repo.description: Owner/repo slug only (e.g., The-Geek-Freaks/NEOTH). No full URI.

C.description: Coupling density: bipartite tool/agent edge density [0,1].

K.description: Convergence pressure: mean pairwise output similarity [0,1].

A.description: Agent density: distinct dispatched agents / autonomy_scalar / 8 [0,1].

D.description: Differentiation capacity (0,1]. v0: 1.0=no schema conflicts, 0.3=any conflict.

H.description: Heterarchy/redundancy (0,1]. H_structural is the primary input; H_empirical is a calibration check.

algorithm_versions.description: Per-feature algorithm version strings. Enables between-version sensitivity analysis.

K_embedding_model.description: HuggingFace model ID used for K_d embeddings, if any.

candidate_scores.description: Domain-prefixed candidate score forms. Key naming convention: B_{domain}_{form}.

B_neoth_log.description: Primary form for cross-instance pooling: log(C)+log(K)+log(M)+log(A)+log(V)-log(D)-log(H). Null when any numerator=0.

B_neoth_mult.description: Multiplicative form, normalised. Null when epsilon not yet calibrated.

B_neoth_mult_epsilon.description: Epsilon value used for B_neoth_mult. Required when B_neoth_mult is non-null.

B_neoth_mult_epsilon_rule.description: Epsilon governance rule: '0.01_median_DH_calibration' for the reference implementation.

B_neoth_bottleneck.description: Bottleneck form: min(C,K,M,A,V) / max(D,H). No epsilon needed.

collapse_within_30m.description: Primary falsification label (30-minute horizon). Null when not yet computed.

collapse_at_next_task.description: Next-task-run horizon label. Null when not in a task-bounded evaluation.

collapse_at_next_task_id.description: Pseudonymised task_id of the next task run.

collapse_kind.description: First firing collapse label for the primary horizon. Canonical enum — single source of truth. See neoth-babel-event.schema.json for the normative definition.

negative_control.description: True for deliberately stable runs where collapse is structurally impossible.

submission_metadata.description: Stratification metadata for pooled analysis. Required for v0.2, optional for v0.1 backward compat.

contributor_id.description: SHA-256(local_secret_salt || repo_slug) — 64 hex chars. Pseudonymous, stable.

pseudonymised_session_id.description: HMAC-SHA256(local_salt, session_id) truncated to 16 hex chars.
